name: BH Global Corporation Limited
summary: Operating as an investment holding company, BH Global Corporation Limited offers a diverse range of solutions globally, specializing in marine and offshore sectors, green LED technologies, integrated technological applications, cybersecurity, and infrared and thermal sensing technologies. The company's operations are structured across four main segments: Electrical and Technical Supply, Green LED Lighting, Security, and Integration Engineering. Within these divisions, BH Global engages in the worldwide trade of goods such as marine cables, lighting equipment, and various accessories. Additionally, it provides advanced cybersecurity solutions, marine surveillance systems, and thermal scanners, alongside offering comprehensive engineering services. A significant aspect of its business involves the research, design, development, and manufacturing of innovative green LED lighting solutions. Furthermore, the company supplies critical mass fever screening systems, utilized in medical facilities, border control, and for managing large groups of people, as well as cutting-edge night vision technologies for various marine and land-based uses. Founded in Singapore in 1963, where its headquarters remain, the company was formerly known as BH Global Marine Limited before officially changing its name to BH Global Corporation Limited in May 2013. It operates as a subsidiary of Beng Hui Holding (S) Pte Ltd.
